title: The global fraud case about toxic waste
summary: On this day in 1986, brothers Jack and Charles Colbert were found guilty in a New York courtroom of running what they called a “surplus chemical business” and what the U.S. government called a notorious global toxic-waste brokerage. The brothers had shipped 238 drums of waste to a chemical company in Zimbabwe, claiming the drums contained valuable industrial solvents. But the drums actually contained “garbage” from a chemical company in Ohio.
